def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # output-boundary overwork grows multiplicatively with the tile overhang
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # register spills cause an abrupt local-memory path
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[1]
    # the final CTA wave can leave SM capacity unused
    s = s + f.tail_waste * w[2]
    # serial split-K exposes a dependency between partial accumulations
    s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[3]
    # parallel split-K adds global partial write/read traffic
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[4]
    # short problems are setup dominated, while larger problems expose
    # steady-state pipeline service and iteration cost differently
    if p.log_flops < 30:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[12]
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[13]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[14]
    else:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[15]
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[16]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[17]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # repeated operand loads are the principal bandwidth cost
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[5]
        # low-intensity CTA tiles consume bandwidth for little arithmetic
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[6]
        # a long raster reuse window reduces cache reuse
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[7]
    else:
        # wide-range front-end work competes with tensor arithmetic
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[8]
        # unfilled thread capacity reduces latency hiding
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[9]
        # register allocation pressure limits concurrent work
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[10]
        # parallel split-K also adds accumulator arithmetic in this regime
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[11]
    # Underfilled shapes expose fixed per-thread work; saturated shapes can
    # trade that burden against the multistage family's pipeline behavior.
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 1024:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_burden_per_thread) * w[18]
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[19]
        # Low output parallelism exposes geometry-induced residency and wave loss.
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * (1.0 + f.tile_aspect_mismatch) * w[23]
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * (1.0 + f.tile_aspect_mismatch) * w[24]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_burden_per_thread) * w[20]
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[21]
        s = s + f.multistage_family_indicator * np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_burden_per_thread) * w[22]
        # In the saturated regime, residency interacts with its resource causes.
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * (f.register_file_pressure + f.shared_memory_pressure) * w[25]
    # Swizzle family has different locality consequences when cache pressure
    # and output geometry put different operand-reuse patterns on the critical path.
    if p.l2_working_set_pressure < 0.5:
        if p.output_aspect_imbalance < 0.5:
            s = s + f.swizzle_type_family_indicator * w[26]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[27]
        else:
            s = s + f.swizzle_type_family_indicator * w[28]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[29]
    else:
        if p.output_aspect_imbalance < 0.5:
            s = s + f.swizzle_type_family_indicator * w[30]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[31]
        else:
            s = s + f.swizzle_type_family_indicator * w[32]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[33]

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Boundary predication: compress the wide output-tile overwork range.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Last-wave idle time grows superlinearly as the surviving wave empties.
    s = s + (-np.log(np.clip(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1.0e-6, 1.0))) * w[1]
    # Registers spilling to local memory are a discontinuous severe penalty.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[2]
    # Spill severity captures the amount of local-memory traffic after that transition.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
    # Split-K partial traffic and serial accumulator round-trips add global-memory work.
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[4]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.serial_reduction_traffic_fraction) * w[5]
    # Serial split-K also removes independent accumulation work.
    s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[6]
    # Pipeline prologue/epilogue and stage-management cost is paid in every regime.
    s = s + np.log2(f.stage_latency_time_ratio) * w[7]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # Below the roofline, replicated operand loads and poor coalescing consume bandwidth.
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[8]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_eviction * w[9]
        s = s + f.operand_contiguity_deficit * w[10]
        s = s + f.output_store_run_density * w[11]
        # Memory-bound K granularity trades extra loop iterations against buffering pressure.
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[12]
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[13]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[14]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[15]
    else:
        if p.log_reduction_depth > 12:
            # Long compute-bound reductions need an explicit issue/resource tradeoff.
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[16]
            s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[17]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[18]
            s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[19]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.thread_instruction_count) * w[20]
            s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[21]
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[22]
            s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[23]
        else:
            # Short compute-bound reductions retain the original occupancy/resource model.
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[24]
            s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[25]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[26]
            s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[27]
            s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[28]
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[29]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[30]
            s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[31]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[1]
    else:
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * np.log2(1.0 + f.tail_waste / np.maximum(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1e-6)) * w[35]
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * np.log2(1.0 + f.grid_instruction_overhead_ratio) * w[36]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.tail_waste / np.maximum(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1e-6)) * w[2]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[4]

    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_critical_path_ratio) * w[12]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        if p.l2_working_set_pressure < 0.5:
            s = s + np.where(p.output_work_per_sm < 4096, np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count), -np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count)) * w[25]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[26]
        else:
            s = s + np.where(p.output_work_per_sm < 4096, np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count), -np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count)) * w[27]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[28]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[6]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[7]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[8]
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[13]
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[14]
            s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[15]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_critical_path_ratio) * f.wave_count_deficit * w[33]
        else:
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[16]
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[17]
            s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[18]
    else:
        if p.l2_working_set_pressure < 0.5:
            s = s + np.where(p.output_work_per_sm < 4096, np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count), -np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count)) * w[29]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[30]
        else:
            s = s + np.where(p.output_work_per_sm < 4096, np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count), -np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count)) * w[31]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[32]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[9]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[10]
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[11]
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[19]
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[20]

            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_critical_path_ratio) * f.wave_count_deficit * w[34]
        else:
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[22]
            s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[23]

    s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[37]
    s = s + f.swizzle_coalescing_mismatch * w[38]
